# Ecomshoot
> Premium E-Commerce Product Photography & Creative Production Agency

## Company Overview
Ecomshoot is a premier commercial product photography studio and post-production house serving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, high-growth Shopify merchants, Amazon enterprise sellers, and international fashion retailers. We specialize in studio-grade white background catalog photography, lifestyle editorial staging, high-fashion apparel model shoots, micro-detailed luxury jewellery imagery, 360-degree interactive product spins, and pixel-precise commercial retouching.

## Commercial Photography Services
- [Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/product-photography.php): High-definition commercial product photography that captures physical textures, authentic color tonality, and structural form to turn casual store visitors into loyal buyers.
- [E-Commerce Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/ecommerce-product-photography.php): Scalable, catalog-ready product photography optimized for Shopify Plus merchants, Amazon FBA power sellers, and multi-channel retailers requiring uncompromising consistency.
- [Lifestyle Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/lifestyle-product-photography.php): Immersive in-context photography that showcases your product in real-world environments, connecting deeply with target demographics and skyrocketing social engagement.
- [Fashion & Apparel Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/fashion-product-photography.php): From architectural ghost mannequin executions and pin-sharp flat lays to dynamic live-model editorial lookbooks, we present fashion with elegance and drape integrity.
- [Creative & Advertising Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/creative-product-photography.php): Concept-driven visual campaigns that disrupt mundane feeds, leveraging bold color theory, kinetic splash capture, levitation techniques, and bespoke set design.
- [Jewellery & Luxury Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/jewellery-product-photography.php): Specialized macro focus-stacking photography designed to eliminate unwanted reflections, reveal diamond facet scintillation, and render precious metals with breathtaking brilliance.
- [Product Photo Editing & Retouching](http://127.0.0.1:8000/product-photo-editing-retouching.php): Transform raw studio captures into museum-quality digital assets with pixel-perfect clipping paths, frequency separation, scratch removal, and master color balancing.
- [White Background Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/white-background-product-photography.php): Pure RGB #255,255,255 white background imagery engineered to pass Amazon, Walmart, and Google Shopping compliance algorithms on the very first upload.
- [Professional Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/professional-product-photography.php): Full-service creative production combining strategic creative direction, medium format camera hardware, master lighting, set styling, and dedicated project management.
